program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 15.0, 24.0),       # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.5, 1.5, 4.0),          # input pair L (flicker)
    "Itail": (10e-6, 7e-6, 12e-6),
    "I2":    (38e-6, 30e-6, 40e-6),
    "gmidp": (13.0, 10.0, 16.0),       # CS PMOS gm/Id
    "gmidl": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),        # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Ll":    (1.2, 0.6, 3.0),          # PMOS mirror-load L
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),          # CS second-stage L
    "gmidn": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "fu":    (21e6, 19e6, 26e6),       # UGBW target -> sets Cc
    "rzk":   (0.8, 0.5, 1.2),
}

def _area(m, L):
    w = getattr(m, "w", None)
    if w is None:
        w = getattr(m, "W", None)
    if w is None:
        return None
    return w * L

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]

    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I2, vds=0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidl"], p["Ll"], It / 2, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidl"], p["Ll"], It / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # Cc from UGBW target
    Cc = m1.gm / (2 * PI * p["fu"])
    # Rz: LHP zero, below the exact p2-cancellation value (robust)
    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1.0 / m6.gm) * (1.0 + cl / Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    g1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    g2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(g1 * g2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    cout = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cout + Cc * (c1 + cout)))
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)) if Rz > 1.0 / m6.gm else -1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (1.0 / m6.gm - Rz))
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * c1)
    cm = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cm)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pmir)))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I2)
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat
    cmrr_db = db(2 * m1.gm * m3.gm / (m5.gds * (m1.gds + m3.gds)) / 2)
    psrr_db = gain_db - 8

    # noise: calibrated to iter-1 sim (134 nV at gmid1=22, L1=3, gmidl=11, Ll=2, It=8u)
    It0 = 8e-6
    r1 = lut.size("n", 22.0, 3.0, It0 / 2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.3)
    r3 = lut.size("p", 11.0, 2.0, It0 / 2, vds=1.1)
    a1, a1r = _area(m1, p["L1"]), _area(r1, 3.0)
    a3, a3r = _area(m3, p["Ll"]), _area(r3, 2.0)
    if a1 is None or a1r is None:
        a1 = p["gmid1"] * p["L1"] ** 2 * It
        a1r = 22.0 * 9.0 * It0
        a3 = p["gmidl"] * p["Ll"] ** 2 * It
        a3r = 11.0 * 4.0 * It0
    k1 = a1r / a1
    k3 = (a3r / a3) * ((m3.gm / m1.gm) / (r3.gm / r1.gm)) ** 2
    s0 = (1.341e-7) ** 2
    noise_1k = math.sqrt(s0 * (0.6 * k1 + 0.4 * k3))

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db}
